purpose: Fast causal prescreen of three fully reconstructible completed-bar price-action families selected for natural event selectivity and plausible immediate 30-second follow-through.

17BE_TBR9_21.source_disclosure: Open-source TradingView description explicitly recommends 1-minute for short scalps and, after the July 2024 update, requires EMA9>EMA21 for bullish reversals and EMA9<EMA21 for bearish reversals.

signal.long: Bar1 closes down; Bar2 low is below Bar1 and Bar3 lows; Bar3 closes above highs of Bar1 and Bar2; EMA9 > EMA21 on completed Bar3.
signal.short: Bar1 closes up; Bar2 high is above Bar1 and Bar3 highs; Bar3 closes below lows of Bar1 and Bar2; EMA9 < EMA21 on completed Bar3.
signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed Bar3 right edge

17BF_PCR.source_disclosure: Open-source no-input TradingView pattern. M1 is a project-target adaptation, not claimed as a source default.

signal.long: Three successively lower closes across Bars3->2->1; current completed bar closes above Bar1; one of Bar1/current has the lowest low of the trailing six completed bars.
signal.short: Three successively higher closes across Bars3->2->1; current completed bar closes below Bar1; one of Bar1/current has the highest high of the trailing ten completed bars.
signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed current-bar right edge

17BG_FAKEY.source_disclosure: ForexFactory rule description: Mother Bar, fully contained Inside Bar, third bar breaks one Mother-Bar wick, fourth bar exceeds the opposite Mother-Bar wick revealing the fake break. XAUUSD M5 examples are present in the same discussion.

signal.long: Mother Bar; next bar fully inside; third bar breaks below Mother low without opposite break; fourth completed bar breaks above Mother high.
signal.short: Mother Bar; next bar fully inside; third bar breaks above Mother high without opposite break; fourth completed bar breaks below Mother low.
signal.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after completed fourth-bar right edge

selection_rule: Any family that passes minimum supply/day and direct-net gate freezes unchanged for independent later-January validation. A family that fails is retired without Stage-A rescue.
